app_fee.value: The one-time non-refundable graduate application fee is $75.
app_fee.quote: The one-time graduate application fee is $75.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers are granted for Clark partner-organization applicants (e.g., Fulbright, AmeriCorps, Peace Corps, McNair Scholars), Clark alumni, and current employees; others may email gradadmissions@clarku.edu for case-by-case consideration.
fee_waiver.quote: On a case-by-case basis, the application fee may be waived. We grant waivers for the following populations: | Applicants from organizations partnered with Clark (e.g., AmeriCorps, Peace Corps, City Year, Fulbright, Teach for America, McNair Scholars, National Association of Black Accountants, among others) | Clark alumni | Current Clark employees | To request a fee waiver outside of these populations, please email gradadmissions@clarku.edu for more information.

gre_general.value: Not required for the Fall 2026 cycle, though strongly suggested for Biology, Physics, Biochemistry, and Chemistry (see individual program records).
gre_general.quote: GRE It is not required for the Fall 2026 cycle, but is strongly suggested for the Economics, Biology, Physics, Biochemistry, and Chemistry programs.

toefl_min.value: Not stated for Ph.D. programs on the Ph.D. requirements page (TOEFL iBT, IELTS, Duolingo, or PTE-Academic scores are required unless exempt; published 85 TOEFL minimums apply to master's programs).

ielts_min.value: Not stated for Ph.D. programs on the Ph.D. requirements page (TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo, or PTE-Academic scores are required unless exempt; published 6.5 IELTS minimums apply to master's programs).

english_waiver.value: India is not on Clark's exempt-country list; exemptions apply only to citizens of or in-person degree holders from listed English-speaking countries (e.g., U.S., U.K., Canada except Quebec, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, Ghana, Kenya, Nigeria).
